summary: EDA ships non-editable built-in credential types for syncing projects, running activations, launching controller job templates, pulling registry images and event streams; create custom types with input and injector configuration for other systems, and use external secret management types when running job templates.
questions: What credential types does Event-Driven Ansible include?
Can I edit built-in EDA credential types?
How do I authenticate a source plugin to a system EDA doesn't support?
